recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining semantic gap for FHIR-25260 while preserving later approved ExampleScenario changes.
issue_request: FHIR-25260 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core ExampleScenario and requested structureVersion string 1..1 plus profile uri 0..* for instances, because a bare type such as Observation is not enough and an instance may be valid against a profile or set of profiles.
initial_application: August 2022 source history added and reworked the relevant fields in commits 022f97b17f and de7f5831c6, the latter explicitly naming FHIR-25260 along with FHIR-37195, FHIR-22855, and FHIR-37895. The application introduced structureVersion and structureProfile[x], but left structureProfile[x] constrained to max 1.
additional_context: FHIR-37895 later revisited FHIR-25260 and approved making structureVersion optional for same-version FHIR structures with an invariant and meaningWhenMissing, and changing profile to structureProfile[x] with uri|canonical. That later decision explains the current structureVersion and type/name choices, but does not remove the seed's repeatable profile requirement. ExampleScenario is active in source/fhir.ini, and no searched Zulip or Confluence evidence contradicted the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Updated source/examplescenario/structuredefinition-ExampleScenario.xml so ExampleScenario.instance.structureProfile[x] has max "*" and updated the checked-in source/examplescenario/examplescenario.svg diagram cardinality to match. Left structureVersion unchanged because FHIR-37895 supersedes the original mandatory-cardinality detail.
source_changes: source/examplescenario/examplescenario.svg: updated the ExampleScenario diagram to show structureProfile[x] as [0..*].
